name: Play! Play! Play! GO!
source:
Shigeru Sato was born with dysfunctional eyes.
He has felt as if he has been just "kept alive", making him moan in despair.
So he finally tries to kill himself... But he is saved for better or for worse.

When he wakes up from days of sleep, however, his eyes perceive the light and colors! His father's social and financial power presented him with transplanted eyes. Everything reflected in his eyes makes him very excited. When a nurse comes into his sight, Shigeru impulsively rapes her!

Having left nothing to look back behind, he becomes a rapist and sets out on an adventure around the country in search of women!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE223746.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
佐藤茂出生时眼睛就有功能障碍。
他感觉自己仿佛被“保住了”，绝望地呻吟着。
所以他最终试图自杀……但无论好坏，他都被救了。

然而，当他从几天的睡眠中醒来时，他的眼睛感知到了光线和颜色！他父亲的社会和经济实力为他提供了移植的眼睛。映入他眼中的一切都让他非常兴奋。当一名护士出现在他的视线中时，茂冲动地强奸了她！

没有留下任何可回头的东西，他成为了一名强奸犯，并开始了全国各地寻找女人的冒险！

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE223746.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
